title: Spatial Gateway, Boundary Diff & Spatial Query Engine

prerequisites.W016_C3_R10: CONDITIONALLY_ACCEPTED (Gap B native renderer deferred to W023)

securityModel.executionMode: 100% SECURITY INVOKER across ALL spatial functions (fn_spatial_calculate_overlap, fn_spatial_boundary_diff, fn_spatial_detect_anomalies). Audit proves SECURITY DEFINER is completely unnecessary because service_role and authenticated already hold SELECT grants and USING (true) RLS policies on public.entity_geometries and public.mandal_versions.
securityModel.privilegeEscalationRisk: ZERO (0). No superuser or postgres ownership elevation; no bypass of RLS; no search_path vulnerability.
securityModel.acl: Per-function least privilege: REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC; fn_spatial_calculate_overlap and fn_spatial_boundary_diff granted to authenticated and service_role; fn_spatial_detect_anomalies granted strictly to service_role. Zero grants to anon.
securityModel.resourceCeilings: SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5000ms'; Max 100 features evaluated per query; Max 2.0x2.0 degree bounding box for anomaly scans.

temporalRegimeSeparation.standard: Typed spatial-selection model reconciled with W014/W016 architecture. 589 TGRAC polygons represent the 2016-10-11 snapshot only and do NOT imply continuous legal validity through 2022.
selectionModes: as_of (point-in-time statutory snapshot via valid_from <= d AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > d))
future (statutorily gazetted or anticipated post-2026 delimitation regime)
temporalRegimeSeparation.failClosedRule: Queries with missing temporal or regime data fail closed. Cross-regime comparisons are explicitly tagged.

identityDisambiguation.entityId: Stable internal primary key mandals.id (UUID or canonical entity ID; distinct from mutable external LGD codes)
identityDisambiguation.geometryId: Physical geometry row UUID in entity_geometries.id
identityDisambiguation.sourceFeatureId: Source artifact feature identifier in original dataset (e.g. GeoJSON/shapefile FID)

areaCalculationMethodology.primaryStandard: ST_Area(geom::geography) in square meters on WGS84 spheroid
areaCalculationMethodology.projectedStandard: Projected planar CRS (e.g. ST_Transform(geom, 32644) for UTM Zone 44N) only when specifically justified per regional extent for planar computational efficiency
areaCalculationMethodology.prohibition: Raw EPSG:4326 angular degree area strictly forbidden
areaCalculationMethodology.precision: Double precision IEEE 754; overlap percentages formatted to 4 decimal places
areaCalculationMethodology.zeroAreaBehavior: Disjoint geometries, dimension < 2 intersections (point/linestring), or invalid geometries yield 0.0 m^2

overlapCalculationRules.precheck: Mandatory bounding box pre-filtering (geom_a && geom_b) prior to geometric intersection
overlapCalculationRules.zeroOverlap: 0.0000% when bounding boxes are disjoint or intersection dimension < 2

anomalyDetectionScope.classification: Governed detection heuristics, NOT legal boundary determinations
anomalyDetectionScope.healing: Automated geometry repair, vertex snapping, or boundary shifting is strictly forbidden
anomalyDetectionScope.configurability: Configurable and versioned anomaly detection threshold profiles

migrationPackaging049.classification: Additive stored functions and analytical views only
migrationPackaging049.reusedIndexes: Leverages existing idx_entity_geometries_spatial (GiST) from Migration 048 without redundant index creation

plannedEndpoints.description: Compute intersection area and quantitative overlap percentage between two entity versions
Compute geometric diff (added/removed areas) across entity versions or regimes
Detect topological slivers, gaps, and invalid boundaries using governed heuristic profiles (read-only)
